description: This file contains a utility function named 'shapeStackedSeries' that processes an array of cost records, organizing and transforming them into a dataset suitable for visualization with a charting library like Recharts. The function aggregates costs by service and category, labels unknown categories, and sorts the categories and services based on options.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a structured dataset with zero-filled stacks for visualization, grouping by specified categories and services.
